answer: Identity vests through a spiral of bonded probes: each probe is a small paid query routed to a distinct established counterparty, and bidding unlocks only after seven probes return unmatched funder clusters across two epochs. A falcon registry records those return paths in public. A gale of clones reuses the same payers, so probes collide and the spiral unwinds. Purchased empty accounts cannot mint distinct paths, so they never vest.
